name: claude-notifications
description: All-in-one Claude Code notifications — sound alerts, OS notifications, and terminal focus. One-click setup, zero external dependencies.

claudeNotifications.autoSetupHooks.markdownDescription: Install and upgrade Claude Code hooks automatically. Uncheck to be prompted before any change to `~/.claude/settings.json`.

claudeNotifications.volume.markdownDescription: `0` = silent, `50` (default) ≈ typical OS notification, `100` = the sound file's native level. Your OS master volume still controls overall loudness.

claudeNotifications.waiting.action.description: What happens when Claude is waiting for your response.

enumItemLabels: Custom file — see Custom Sound Path below
enumDescriptions: Toast/banner still shows but no sound plays.

claudeNotifications.waiting.sound.markdownDescription: Sound for this event. [**Choose Sound…**](command:claudeNotifications.chooseSound?%5B%22waiting%22%5D) picks from your OS's system sounds with click-to-preview; [**Preview**](command:claudeNotifications.previewSound) plays your current sounds.

claudeNotifications.waiting.customSoundP.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a custom audio file. Used only when the Sound above is set to `Custom file`.

enumDescriptions: Play the configured audio cue when you're already on the matching terminal.
Suppress the audio cue when you're already on the matching terminal.
claudeNotifications.soundWhenFocused.description: Audio behaviour when you're already on the terminal Claude just wrote to. (Visible toast is controlled separately by claudeNotifications.toastWhenFocused.)

claudeNotifications.toastWhenFocused.description: Show an in-window info toast when you're already on the matching terminal. Default off — the audio cue alone is usually enough since you're looking at the terminal. Enable for a visual cue alongside (or instead of) the sound, e.g. multi-monitor / small-terminal-panel setups, or accessibility.

enumDescriptions: Identifies the specific VS Code instance that produced the notification via its process tree and focuses its window directly via Win32 SetForegroundWindow. Required when you have multiple VS Code windows open — the `code` CLI otherwise routes to whichever instance is most recently focused, not the one Claude is in.

Routes the click through the `code <workspace>` CLI. Always worked for single-instance setups; can land on the wrong window when multiple VS Code instances are open. Use this only if the default HWND path misbehaves on your machine.
claudeNotifications.windows.clickBehavio.deprecationMessage: Since v3.5.5 Windows toast clicks route through VS Code's own URI handler, which doesn't use this setting. It only applies to the legacy claude-notif:// launcher path.
claudeNotifications.windows.clickBehavio.markdownDescription: Windows only, legacy. How a `claude-notif://` launcher click resolves which VS Code window to focus. Since v3.5.5 the toast click routes through VS Code's URI handler instead, so this setting normally has no effect.
